title_sq: Okazion! Tek Kompleksi Aura, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Mundesi Ideale Investimi !!

title_en: Opportunity! At Aura Complex, 1+1 Apartment for Sale, Ideal Investment Opportunity!!
description_en: At Aura Complex, 1+1 Apartment For Sale, With Perfect Orientation!!! The apartment with a total area of ​​62.87 m2 is located on the 4th residential floor of one of the complex's buildings and is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, a bedroom, a bathroom and a balcony. The complex is organized with two floors of underground parking, the ground floor is completely dedicated to business premises and 10 residential floors will be developed above. Some of the benefits of the complex are: facade coated with thermal insulation, hood system, double-glazed windows with gas filling to minimize noise and thermal insulation, acoustic insulation in the partitions between apartments and central heating system. The inner courtyard is a space filled with benches and greenery, at the back of the complex, its north-eastern part.
